chunks: We mention a portion of the narrations that encompass this meaning, so that the truth of what we have said may be known, because the complete inclusion of all that has been narrated in this regard would be lengthy, and it is present in the books of traditions; whoever wishes may refer to it from there.
ai.seo_question: Why does the author present only a portion of the narrations regarding the occultation?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Tusi employs this methodological note to justify the selective presentation of narrations, acknowledging that a comprehensive compilation would be excessively lengthy. This approach reflects the scholarly tradition of providing sufficient evidence for verification while directing serious students to the broader corpus of *kutub al-akhbar* for deeper study.
